principles: Use the real subject, exact claims and a clear hierarchy; do not invent proof or metrics.
Measure the complete text layout before animation. Keep existing words fixed during reveals.
One display role, one supporting role, coherent spacing and safe frame margins.
Plan a quick entrance, a readable settled hold and an intentional exit.
Preserve approved caption fonts, compact ink gaps, word order, black backgrounds and pattern identity.
Keep familiar application controls. This is scene design guidance, not a website redesign.

recipes.idea: Resolve the entire row first; reveal words in fixed slots. Motion should guide attention without moving already-readable text.

Hook, reveal, concrete highlights, then a short close. Show actual product material when supplied; never invent screenshots, customers or claims. Give short labels at least 0.8 seconds settled and longer phrases roughly 0.3 seconds per word.
Show the process in causal order. Reveal steps with a small stagger, then hold the complete set so it can be read. Keep measurements exactly as supplied.
Enter the relevant visual at the spoken idea, settle for identification, drift gently, then exit before the next subject. No cursor, click effects or random decorative motion.
Use the orbital sphere as a separate optional scene layer. Keep type clear of its dense center. Seek absolute time and use fixed seeded geometry.
